subject.title: fix: reject invalid channel account selections

question: Should upgraded installations uniformly fail closed for every explicitly supplied invalid, disabled, conflicting, or channel-mismatched channel account ID, rather than retaining any fallback behavior?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but it deliberately changes an existing runtime outcome for callers that supplied an explicit bad account; repository policy treats removed fallback behavior and routing changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept strict explicit routing
options.body: Merge with invalid explicit account IDs rejected everywhere, while omitted and host-derived defaults keep their current behavior.

options.title: Retain a compatibility fallback
options.body: Do not merge this behavior as written; define a documented opt-in strict mode or migration path if historical explicit-account fallback must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Accept strict explicit routing
recommendation.body: Merge with invalid explicit account IDs rejected everywhere, while omitted and host-derived defaults keep their current behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history ties this contributor most directly to the routing behavior, though the final compatibility decision should be made by an authorized repository owner.
